title: Verify Service Manager can process a payment on an invoice
preconds:
Log in to ShopView as a user assigned the Service Manager role. (this role has Invoicing and Payments: Create and Edit).
The work order already has an invoice created on its Finance tab.
steps:
1. Open the work order's Finance tab.
2. On the invoice, click the option to record/process a payment.
3. Enter a payment amount and save.
expected: The payment is recorded successfully and shows against the invoice.
